record.bible_text: I am come<WH0935><WTH8804> into my garden<WH01588>, my sister<WH0269>, <FI>my<Fi> spouse<WH03618>: I have gathered<WH0717><WTH8804> my myrrh<WH04753> with my spice<WH01313>; I have eaten<WH0398><WTH8804> my honeycomb<WH03293> with my honey<WH01706>; I have drunk<WH08354><WTH8804> my wine<WH03196> with my milk<WH02461>: eat<WH0398><WTH8798>, O friends<WH07453>; drink<WH08354><WTH8798>, yea, drink abundantly<WH07937><WTH8798>, O beloved<WH01730>. <RF>yea...: or, and be drunken with loves<Rf><CM>

My beloved<WH01730> put in<WH07971><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> by<WH04480> the hole<WH02356> <FI>of the door<Fi> , and my bowels<WH04578> were moved<WH01993><WTH8804> for him. <RF>for him: or, (as some read) in me<Rf>

I opened<WH06605><WTH8804> to my beloved<WH01730>; but my beloved<WH01730> had withdrawn<WH02559><WTH8804> himself, <FI>and<Fi> was gone<WH05674><WTH8804>: my soul<WH05315> failed<WH03318><WTH8804> when he spake<WH01696><WTH8763>: I sought<WH01245><WTH8765> him, but I could not find<WH04672><WTH8804> him; I called<WH07121><WTH8804> him, but he gave me no answer<WH06030><WTH8804>.

The watchmen<WH08104><WTH8802> that went about<WH05437><WTH8802> the city<WH05892> found<WH04672><WTH8804> me, they smote<WH05221><WTH8689> me, they wounded<WH06481><WTH8804> me; the keepers<WH08104><WTH8802> of the walls<WH02346> took away<WH05375><WTH8804> my veil<WH07289> from me.

I charge<WH07650><WTH8689> you, O daughters<WH01323> of Jerusalem<WH03389>, if ye find<WH04672><WTH8799> my beloved<WH01730>, that ye tell<WH05046><WTH8686> him, that I <FI>am<Fi> sick<WH02470><WTH8802> of love<WH0160>. <RF>that ye: Heb. what, etc<Rf><CM>

What <FI>is<Fi> thy beloved<WH01730> more than <FI>another<Fi> beloved<WH01730>, O thou fairest<WH03303> among women<WH0802>? what <FI>is<Fi> thy beloved<WH01730> more than <FI>another<Fi> beloved<WH01730>, that thou<WH03602> dost so charge<WH07650><WTH8689> us?
My beloved<WH01730> <FI>is<Fi> white<WH06703> and ruddy<WH0122>, the chiefest<WH01713><WTH8803> among ten thousand<WH07233>. <RF>the chiefest: Heb. a standard-bearer<Rf>
